*   `?g A5`: Main Concept is A5 (Literature / Writing / Book).
    *   `+ C1`: A detail about the main concept is C1 (Baby – Child / Young / New).
    *   `!r Green`: A sub-concept (red) is the color Green. (Note: Sub-concept `!r` with color Green implies the *clue* describes something green).
    *   `!y A14`: A sub-concept (yellow) is A14 (Food / Eating / Edible).
    *   `+ Green`: A detail about the yellow sub-concept is Green.
    *   `!b A14`: A sub-concept (blue) is A14 (Food / Eating / Edible).
    *   `+ D12`: A detail about the blue sub-concept is D12 (Leg / Foot).

    *   `?g A5` (Literature/Writing/Book) + `+ C1` (Young/Child) -> Children's book?
    *   `!r Green` (Red sub-concept) -> Related to Green.
    *   `!y A14` (Yellow sub-concept) + `+ Green` (Yellow detail is Green?) -> Wait, the notation says:
        `!y A14` (Yellow sub-concept is Food)
        `+ Green` (Cube on Green swatch in the yellow group).
        So, a yellow clue involves Food and the color Green? This might mean the food is green.
    *   `!b A14` (Blue sub-concept) + `+ D12` (Blue detail is Leg/Foot).
        So, a blue clue involves Food and Legs/Feet.
